title: UD Quon 25420 FUPS Hi-tensile Polished Aluminium Bullbar #2
description: UD Quon GW25420 hi-tensile FUPS aluminium Bullbar. heavy duty contoured channel to suit factory fitted driving, fog and indicator lights. Custom low level contour design to allow for daily checks to be completed without lowering the Bullbar. Hi-tensile 76mm tube are recessed into the uprights and reinforced on the outer channel mount. Tow pin and heavy duty steel backing plate.
